# Japan trip: packing checklist

Things to pack and arrange before the flight in April.

## Documents

- [ ] Passport, valid at least six months after return
- [ ] Printed flight tickets and hotel confirmations
- [ ] Travel insurance card
- [ ] Driving licence and the international permit

## Things to pack

- [ ] Universal power adapter (type A plugs)
- [ ] Light rain jacket
- [ ] Comfortable walking shoes, we will walk a lot
- [ ] Small towel, many public toilets have no paper towels
- [ ] Coin purse, cash is still common

## Before leaving

- [ ] Order the rail pass online
- [ ] Notify the bank about card use abroad
- [ ] Download offline maps
